get_year_progress: compute year progress normalized to [0,1) from seconds since epoch for weather model features
get_day_progress: compute day progress normalized to [0,1) from seconds since epoch and longitude arrays
featurize_progress: derive sin and cos features from a progress variable for ML model inputs
add_derived_vars: add year and day progress features to an xarray dataset in place
add_tisr_var: add top-of-atmosphere incident solar radiation feature to an xarray dataset in place
